data.description: Fully Furnished | Prime Location | Close to Sunmarke School
data.long_description:
Villa for rent in Jumeirah Village Triangle

• 2 Bedrooms + Maids
• Upgraded villa
• Close to Sanmarke school
• Prime location
• Opposite park and tennis courts
• 2690sq.ft Bua
• 8021sq.ft Plot
• Huge garden
• Upgraded kitchen with premium appliances
• Covered garage
• Furnished

I’m excited to present this stunning villa located in the highly sought-after District 5 of Jumeirah Village Triangle.

The ground floor features a spacious open-plan living and dining area, along with a fully upgraded kitchen equipped with an integrated water purifier. There’s also a guest bathroom and a maid’s room.

Large patio doors open up to a beautifully maintained garden — perfect for families and entertaining
guests.

Upstairs, you’ll find two bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom and built-in wardrobes. The master bedroom offers a private balcony, a larger en-suite, and extra wardrobe space for added
convenience.

This villa is ideally situated close to award-winning schools, parks, and green spaces — making it a perfect home for families. It sits on a large plot away from main roads, offering peace and privacy.

One of the standout features is the private water well installed by the owner, which helps reduce DEWA
bills, as the garden irrigation uses the collected water.

The property is available either furnished or unfurnished. Feel free to contact me to arrange a viewing — I’d be happy to show you this beautifully upgraded home.
